verses.sivasutra_span-p01_1: I bow to that whose opening and closing make the worlds dissolve and arise — to him, source of the power-wheel's glory, Śaṅkara.
verses.sivasutra_span-p01_2: Where this whole effect abides, and whence it has come forth — from being uncovered in form, there is no obstruction anywhere.
verses.sivasutra_span-p01_3: Even in waking and the rest, in difference, it glides in the undifferent; the perceiver-ness never turns back from its own being.
verses.sivasutra_span-p01_4: I happy, I suffering, I attached, and the like — those awarenesses plainly abide elsewhere, strung on pleasure-states.
verses.sivasutra_span-p01_5: Where there is no suffering, no joy, no graspable, no grasper, and not even delusion — THAT is, ultimately.
verses.sivasutra_span-p01_6: Since the sense-host, deluded, thinks itself undeluded — forthgoing, standing, dissolving, by the inner wheel.
verses.sivasutra_span-p01_7: By that effort the to-be-examined reality is got respectfully; since its freedom is everywhere unmade.
verses.sivasutra_span-p02_8: Not as impeller of wishing does it proceed, but, but — from self-power's touch, the person becomes like that.
verses.sivasutra_span-p02_9: Incapable of own purity, desiring things to be done — when agitation dissolves, then may there be the supreme state.
verses.sivasutra_span-p02_10: Then his unmade nature, marked by knowing and doing; all he desires, he knows and does.
verses.sivasutra_span-p02_11: Regarding his own nature as presiding, he abides as if smiling — whence, for him, this evil course?
verses.sivasutra_span-p02_12: Non-being goes to be-becomeness, and there is no undelusion; since, from contact's application — then thus it was certain.
verses.sivasutra_span-p02_13: Hence that made thing is to be known as ever like deep sleep; but not as thus being-remembered does that reality attain.
verses.sivasutra_span-p02_14: State-pair, called effect-doer-ness; effect-ness waning there, doer-ness again unwaning.
verses.sivasutra_span-p03_15: Whatever mere effort faces effect is lost here; 'I am utterly lost' — so the unwise holds.
verses.sivasutra_span-p03_16: But who inward-facing is, the seat of all-knowingness; his loss can never be, from perceiving no other at all.
verses.sivasutra_span-p03_17: His perception ever, unfailing in three states; ever the fully awake's — but the other's, at beginning and end.
verses.sivasutra_span-p03_18: Whose form is knowing and knowable, yoked by supreme power — in two states the pervader shines, elsewhere consciousness-made.
verses.sivasutra_span-p03_19: Spanda-flows beginning with qualities, from resting in common spanda — may they be, of the unopposed knower, ever.
verses.sivasutra_span-p03_20: Of unawakened minds, eager to hide self-standing — they cast down on the hard-to-cross, terrible wandering road.
verses.sivasutra_span-p04_21: Hence ever striving, spanda-reality discerning; waking indeed, their own state soon attains.
verses.sivasutra_span-p04_22: Angry, thrilled, or 'what shall I do?' — or musing, running: whatever step it takes, there spanda is established.
verses.sivasutra_span-p04_23: Which state soever seized, whatever this tells me — that I will do: thus resolved, he stands.
verses.sivasutra_span-p04_24: Her, by the upper path resorting — moon and sun, the twain — in the middle channel set, the brahma-egg range left.
verses.sivasutra_span-p04_25: Then in that great sky, moon and sun dissolved and gone — like deep-sleep: deluded or awakened may be uncovered.
verses.sivasutra_span-p05_30: On wisdom's dissolving, dream-seeing born of that.
verses.sivasutra_span-p06_33: Of kalā and the rest, of realities — non-discernment is māyā.
verses.sivasutra_span-p06_34: In the body, the dissolving of parts.
verses.sivasutra_span-p06_37: From delusion's conquering, from endless enjoying — the innate-wisdom conquest.
verses.sivasutra_span-p06_40: The stage is the inner self.
verses.sivasutra_span-p07_46: Seat-abiding, happily dived in the lake.
verses.sivasutra_span-p07_49: In ka-class etc, the great-lady etc, the bound mothers.
verses.sivasutra_span-p07_50: In three, the fourth to be poured like oil.
verses.sivasutra_span-p07_51: Sunk, by own mind should enter.
verses.sivasutra_span-p07_54: In mothers, on non-certainty joining — of the destroyed, again rising.
verses.sivasutra_span-p08_59: Who un-shepherded standing, is cause of knowing, and —
verses.sivasutra_span-p08_62: In its proceeding even, non-rejecting, from knower-being.
verses.sivasutra_span-p08_70: From prattling, outward going of the to-be-carried.
verses.sivasutra_span-p08_71: When that ascended measured, from that wasting, life wasting.
verses.sivasutra_span-p08_72: Element-sheathed, then freed again — lord-equal, supreme.
verses.sivasutra_span-p08_74: From nose-inside-middle restraint, what here, in left-right-middle channels?
